accent-hover.$description: On dark, primary-button hover LIGHTENS the accent (the light-theme value darkens). Tracks the live brand override.

link.$description: Brightened on dark so links read clearly as links and stay distinct from the solid accent button background.

accent-text.$description: On dark, accent-hued text LIGHTENS the accent (the light-theme value darkens): the solid dark accent measured 3.2:1 on its own 16% tint. Same 70% weight as --uix-link.

success.$description: Calibrated (HAR-1562): dark status TEXT tokens share one lightness band (OKLCH L 74-80%, C <= 0.10) near --uix-text-hushed, SOLIDS C <= 0.14, tints = solid at 12% alpha. The old #00D294 (C 0.165) glowed against dark surfaces.

success-text.$description: Success-toned TEXT on dark: 9.5:1 on --uix-surface, 8.0:1 on its own tint.

warning.$description: On dark --uix-warning carries the calibrated warning TEXT value, because --uix-warning-text chains to it (var(--uix-warning,...)) and that chain is part of the contract. The fill/dot role is --uix-warning-solid.

warning-border.$description: On dark, a deeper amber than the bright --uix-warning so the outline reads as a tone rather than a highlight; 6:1 on --uix-surface #111111.

warning-text.$description: On dark, warning text tracks --uix-warning live (fallback to the dark warning value, calibrated by HAR-1562: 9.7:1 on --uix-surface, 8.1:1 on its own tint).

info-text.$description: On dark, the deep --uix-info #2563EB (a fill with white text, unchanged) fails as text on the faint info tint. Calibrated (HAR-1562): 8.8:1 on --uix-surface, 7.6:1 on its own tint.

danger.$description: The dark danger FILL (critical pill, danger button) with white --uix-danger-fg on it: 5.4:1. Calmer than the old #DC2626 (C 0.215).

danger-border.$description: On dark, the danger solid as an outline; 5.7:1 on --uix-surface #111111.

danger-text.$description: On dark, danger-toned TEXT for pill/field-error/stat-trend/menu/node/audit. Calibrated (HAR-1562): 8.2:1 on --uix-surface, 7.1:1 on its own tint. --uix-danger stays the solid critical-pill / button bg (with white --uix-danger-fg).

amber.$description: SEV-3 tone lightened for dark surfaces (the light-mode ochre #C98A1E is too dark on dark).

amber-text.$description: On dark, amber TEXT in the calibrated status-text band (HAR-1562: C <= 0.10; the old #E6B25C was C 0.12).

attention.$description: Dark attention solid (HAR-1562 calibration; the light-mode #EA580C is too dark on dark).

attention-text.$description: On dark, attention TEXT: 8.9:1 on --uix-surface, reads AA on the faint attention-bg.

overdue.$description: Dark overdue solid (HAR-1562 calibration; the light-mode #DC2626 fails on dark).

overdue-text.$description: On dark, overdue TEXT: 8.8:1 on --uix-surface, reads AA on the faint overdue-bg.

chart-1.$description: Categorical palette, dark: the same eight hues stepped for the dark band (L 0.48-0.67) and validated against --uix-surface #111111 (HAR-1552).

row-selected-bg.$description: Dark-mode selection wash — stronger than row-pinned-bg (rgba(48,128,255,.08)) so selected rows read apart from pinned.
